text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My name is Victoire Pisa.
It's a pleasure to work with you.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
To create a world where all loneliness ceases to exist...
I believe racing holds that power.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
For that sake, I run.
To connect the hearts of those watching and create a ring of hope.
For a world where nobody cries alone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
